# fct_whatsapp__chapter_chats

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_whatsapp__chapter_chats` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for parsed WhatsApp messages from Fora chapter and hub group chats. Each row represents one message, with sender matched to an advisor user ID where possible. Sourced from raw Airbyte-ingested .txt chat exports stored in Google Drive.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `whatsapp_message_id` | Primary Key. Synthetic ID generated by hashing chapter_chat_id, sent_at, sender, and message_text. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `_airbyte_extracted_at` | Timestamp when Airbyte extracted this row from the source. >> SOURCE - Airbyte |
| `attachments` | Array of attachment filenames referenced in the message. Empty array if no attachments. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `chapter` | The mapped feature tag name for the chapter or hub (e.g. "chapter_den", "hub_hvn", "fora_x"). Derived from chapter_chat_id. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `chat_name` | The filename of the chat, including spaces. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `chapter_chat_id` | The source .txt filename with spaces replaced by underscores and .txt removed (e.g. "chat-DEN_Pro_X_Advisors"). Identifies which chat file the message came from. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `message_text` | The body of the message with attachment references stripped out. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `sender` | Raw sender label as it appears in the WhatsApp export (name or phone number). >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `sent_at` | Timestamp of when the message was sent. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `source_file_url` | Google Drive URL of the source .txt file this message was parsed from. >> SOURCE - WhatsApp |
| `user_id` | Foreign Key. The portal user ID of the advisor matched to the sender. Null if no match could be found. >> SOURCE - Portal |
